name: Easysecure import export Quizzes
author: imminentsoftwares

sections.description:
EasySecure Import Export Quizzes is a lightweight tool built specifically for LearnDash quizzes and questions.

This plugin allows you to:
– Export single or multiple LearnDash quizzes
– Export quiz questions with answers and correct answers
– Import quizzes and questions in bulk using CSV/XLSX files
– Backup and migrate quiz data between LearnDash sites

⚠️ Note:
This plugin works only with LearnDash Quizzes & Questions.
It does NOT handle courses, lessons, or topics.

Features

  • Export LearnDash quizzes to CSV or XLSX
  • Export quiz questions with:
    • Question title & description
    • Question type
    • Answers
    • Correct answers
  • Bulk export multiple quizzes
  • Import quizzes & questions using structured CSV/XLSX
  • Supports media inside quiz and question content
  • Clean & lightweight — no course-related logic included
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the LearnDash LMS plugin.
  2. Upload the easysecure-import-export-quizzes folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Go to EasySecure → Import Export Quizzes in the WordPress admin menu.
sections.faq:
What file formats are supported?

You can import and export quizzes using CSV and XLSX formats.

Can I export multiple quizzes at once?

Yes, you can bulk export multiple quizzes from the quizzes list page.

Does this plugin export courses or lessons?

No. This plugin is strictly limited to quizzes and quiz questions only.

What happens if an import fails?

If an import fails, an error message will be displayed.
Please ensure your CSV/XLSX file follows the required format.
